ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

2. Which response best shows understanding of Translation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Translation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Translation of the Qur’an.
   C. Use Translation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Translation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins.
   D. Apply the teaching of Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.
   B. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Founders of Schools of jurisprudence to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Founders of Schools of jurisprudence.
   D. Say Founders of Schools of jurisprudence has no place in daily life.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

7. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Finance? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic Finance has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Islamic Finance to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Finance.
   D. Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc.

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Ulum al- Hadith has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

13. Which response best shows understanding of Ijtihad? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ijtihad has no place in daily life.
